I have now talked to the hotel and here is what I have for you.

1. The hotel promised me that they would fix the code so it would also be valid until monday the 7th.

2. The staff who handles discounts have vacation and wont be able to fix the code for another three weeks, but you can send an e-mail to the same adress I earlier stated and they can manually fix your reservation. ()

Messages.Author: Forhead
Messages.Body:
Hey guys!

We know that the price of the EC are a bit high. Though it's not much we can do about it. The Nordic countries are expensive (and especially Stockholm) - we were aware of that from the get go. But with that in mind we'vedone our out must to keep the prices down. That has been our primary goal. We've manage to get the prices for the conferance rooms down to a third of the normal price.

My and Randy hope that this won't be deterant and that you still will be able to show up.
